rules: Selected row(s) identify exact class/lesson combinations.
All matching student rows are marked Completed.
Success is silent; warning/failure MsgBoxes remain.
Affect only exact selected lesson; never reopen Completed rows.
Current row Remarks=Completed till slide X; Status=Slide X.
Copy same lesson to next future row for each matching student; Remarks=Start from slide X; Status=Ready.
Next future row M/PLSS Informed=Not Applicable because PreLesson Sheets were already issued.
Next future row N/HW Informed remains blank because homework is still outstanding.
Create one new row per unique student in physical class, bottom-to-top.
New row A-D,G,K,L copied; E blank before planning; F=0 plus cell comment Continuing lesson; H/Received=0; I,J,M,N blank.
Track new row belonging to originally selected student as insertions shift rows.
After all rows created, select its column E and call LessonPlan exactly once; LessonPlan fills the class continuation rows.
Supports Y6MS1..Y6MS19 as separate family Y6MS.
Do not rename Drive Y6MS folders to Y6Mxx to accommodate old parser.
